title.zh: 等离子体场：密度与能量分开看
title.en: Plasma fields: distinguish density from energy

subtitle.zh: 离子通量 / 能量/入射角/反应物
subtitle.en: Ion flux / energy / incidence angle / reactants

body.zh: 01；RF匹配；射频能量耦合；到放电腔体
body.en: 01 RF matching Couple RF energy into the discharge chamber

body.zh: 02 电离解离；产生等离子体和；活性中性粒子
body.en: 02 Ionization and dissociation Generate plasma and reactive neutral species

body.zh: 03；粒子扩散；在源区内扩散并；向下输运
body.en: 03 Particle diffusion Diffuse within the source region and transport downward

body.zh: 04；鞘层建立；晶圆表面形成鞘层；产生强电场
body.en: 04 Sheath formation A sheath forms at the wafer surface and creates a strong electric field

body.zh: 05；偏压加速；离子在鞘层中加速；获得方向性与能量
body.en: 05 Bias acceleration Ions accelerate through the sheath and acquire directionality and energy

body.zh: 06；表面去除；化学反应与物理轰击；共同实现刻蚀
body.en: 06 Surface removal Chemical reaction and physical bombardment jointly produce etching

body.zh: RF源区；射频电源；（源功率）
body.en: RF source region RF power supply (source power)

body.zh: 源区；高密度等离子体；产生反应物
body.en: Source region High-density plasma generates reactants

body.zh: 离子；电子；中性粒子；（反应物）
body.en: Ion Electron Neutral species (reactant)

body.zh: 鞘层；建立电位降；加速离子
body.en: Sheath Establish a potential drop to accelerate ions

body.zh: 晶圆；晶圆偏压；（偏压功率或波形）
body.en: Wafer Wafer bias (bias power or waveform)

body.zh: 源功率与空间耦合；• 等离子体密度；• 中性粒子浓度；• 气相反应路径；•影响通量分布
body.en: Source power and spatial coupling • Plasma density • Neutral-species concentration • Gas-phase reaction pathways • Affects flux distribution

body.zh: 偏压功率或波形；• 离子能量；• 入射角分布；• 表面热负荷；• 潜在损伤
body.en: Bias power or waveform • Ion energy • Incidence-angle distribution • Surface heat load • Potential damage

body.zh: RF匹配与阻抗；• 能量耦合效率；• 放电稳定性；• 等离子体均匀性；• 减少反射损耗
body.en: RF matching and impedance • Energy-coupling efficiency • Discharge stability • Plasma uniformity • Reduced reflected-power loss

body.zh: 场型控制（按设备）；•电场与磁场分布；•离子角度控制；•径向均匀性；•适配不同结构
body.en: Field-shape control (tool dependent) • Electric- and magnetic-field distribution • Ion-angle control • Radial uniformity • Adaptation to different structures

body.zh: 源功率 ↔ 粒子通量与气相化学；主要影响等离子体密度与中性反应物，；决定离子通量及其径向分布
body.en: Source power ↔ particle flux and gas-phase chemistry Mainly affects plasma density and neutral reactants, determining ion flux and its radial distribution

body.zh: 相互耦合；共同决定；刻蚀结果
body.en: Mutual coupling Jointly determine etch results

body.zh: 偏压 ↔ 离子能量、热负荷与损伤；主要影响离子能量与入射角，；并带来表面热负荷与潜在损伤
body.en: Bias ↔ ion energy, heat load and damage Mainly affects ion energy and incidence angle, while imposing surface heat load and potential damage

body.zh: 密度径向偏差；RF失配；离子角度偏斜
body.en: Radial density bias RF mismatch Ion-angle deflection

body.zh: 量测反馈：RF电压电流 / OES / 刻蚀图；RF电压电流；OES；刻蚀图；反馈优化工艺
body.en: Metrology feedback: RF voltage/current / OES / etch map RF voltage/current OES Etch map Feedback optimizes the process

body.zh: 典型风险
body.en: Typical risks

topic: 刻蚀均匀性与腔体控制
